environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x runtime) triggered by S3 PutObject events. The Lambda execution role has the same managed policies but is subject to an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/LambdaProcessingBoundary) that uses an explicit Deny with StringNotEquals condition on aws:RequestedRegion for all non-read actions, and the Organization has SCP 'RestrictLambdaNetworking' applied to the OU containing this account which denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface unless the VPC endpoint policy restricts egress to specific S3/DynamoDB/SNS service endpoints only. The Lambda function's VPC has NO NAT gateway and only interface VPC endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, and SNS with endpoint policies restricting to the specific resource ARNs. The security group attached to the Lambda ENI has outbound rules allowing only port 443 to the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-xxxxx). DNS resolution within the VPC is handled by Route 53 Resolver with a forwarding rule that resolves only *.amazonaws.com domains.

config.vpc_endpoint_policies: restricted to specific resource ARNs only
config.security_group_egress: port 443 to VPC endpoint prefix list only
config.permission_boundary_effect: Explicit Deny on all actions except s3:GetObject, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:GetItem, sns:Publish, logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents with resource conditions
config.scp: RestrictLambdaNetworking - denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface unless vpc endpoint policy restricts egress
